title: A Inventory for the Aftermath
author: Juniper Almeida
blurb: Yara Kavanagh, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
